entries.title: Choose your Look's fonts
entries.body: Pick the title and figure faces under Card styles in the Look editor; the cards, the stage summary and the running clock all draw with them.

entries.title: Long stage names fit the cards
entries.body: A long stage name on the title page, a slate or the lower third shrinks to fit the frame, and ends in an ellipsis when it still does not.

entries.title: Palettes that stand out on your footage
entries.body: The Look editor suggests full palettes from one colour, from your club logo, from ready-made range palettes, or from what stands out on this match's own footage.

entries.title: Write your own card templates
entries.body: In the desktop app, the Look editor's Templates tab edits a card's HTML with a live preview, the data it receives and a check that names the broken line.

entries.title: Make your own Look
entries.body: Duplicate a Look under Look, Advanced on the Export page, pick its colours and card styles, and see it on your own footage before you save.

entries.title: Transitions between stages
entries.body: An MP4 can cross from one stage to the next with a fade, a wipe or a dozen other moves, each with a direction. The compare grid gets them too.

entries.title: Stings in your colours
entries.body: A sting sweeps a band in your Look's colours across the cut between stages, carrying the club logo when there is one. Pick Wipe sting under transitions.

entries.title: Cards that rise into place
entries.body: Choose the Rise style for the title page, the stage slates, the lower third or the closing card, and their lines animate in.

entries.title: Your club colour and logo
entries.body: Give each shooter an accent colour, a club line and a logo on the Footage page. The cards, the sting and the stage summary use them.

entries.title: A better beep finder
entries.body: The first beep suggested for a stage is now the right one far more often, so there is less to confirm by hand.

entries.title: Smoother scrubbing in Audit
entries.body: Audit plays a lighter 720p copy of each trim, so seeking stays quick on long 4K clips.

entries.title: Clips you already imported
entries.body: Adding a clip again, even from another folder, is recognised and skipped, and the import says why it skipped each file.

entries.title: Your division on the title page
entries.body: The title page prints the shooter's division as the scoreboard has it. Turn it off under Details on the Export page.
